meta.title: Fall 2026 Campaign Planner
meta.intro: This planner maps upcoming campaign + web milestones, what Bald will share, and what FJC needs to provide at each step. Because workstreams are moving in parallel, timely consolidated feedback and approvals keep dependent work moving.
meta.deadlineNote: Any feedback or approval delay will impact the remaining timeline and the launch date.
notes: Most deliverables include one refinement round (V1 → feedback → V2/final). FJC will provide one consolidated response within the noted feedback window. Changes to previously approved work may require rework and impact timing and/or scope.
Dates are projected and subject to change pending client feedback timing and requests.
Rounds of revisions are maximum projected revisions within the timeline as required — without feedback we will assume approval to keep the project moving.
Status is refreshed at each milestone checkpoint, not continuously.

actionKey.FEEDBACK: Bald will refine based on your notes; not yet locked.
actionKey.APPROVAL: Work is locked and downstream work proceeds on this basis.
actionKey.CLIENT INPUT: Information, specs, or decisions needed from FJC to progress.
actionKey.NO ACTION: Nothing needed from FJC at this step.

statusKey.ON TRACK: Moving as planned; no known blockers.
statusKey.AT RISK: Depends on something not yet locked; could slip if that slips.

dependencies.why: The selected name needs to be incorporated into the identity system.

dependencies.unlocks: Asset design & production, landing page design
dependencies.why: Assets and landing page design need to use the approved identity system; earlier exploration can be used directionally.
Design needs confirmed priorities, formats, specs, mandatory content + camp/partner requirements. Toolkit needs a confirmed mix of asset templates.
Copy can progress alongside messaging refinement and finalize once messaging is approved.
Final asset layouts need to be right-sized to accommodate approved copy.
Page structure and content need to be established before visual design can begin.
Development builds the approved design; changes that reopen UX/UI during development may impact timing and/or scope.
Staging and client QA need to be complete before the site can be approved for launch.
Approved toolkit content and templates need to be finalized before production files can be prepared and handed over.

revisionsNote: Revision rounds are planned around the current timeline and assume consolidated feedback within the agreed review windows. Additional revisions or changes to previously approved work may impact timing and/or scope. Wireframes & Copy increased to 2 rounds (V2 + Final) to fully lock copy before UI begins.

phases.what: V1 review + 2 revision rounds (V2, then Final).
phases.locks: Page structure, functionality, hierarchy + ~99% of copy.
Visual design, imagery, responsive behavior + final copy.

workflows.title: How the asset + toolkit workflow moves

phases.what: Confirm Campaign ID, priority assets, requirements + specs.
Develop asset copy against the refined messaging direction.
Apply the approved identity + copy across priority assets.
Package approved assets, templates + messaging for camps.
Prepare final files and equip camps for launch.
